TinySoundFont v0.9
Upstream: https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont
Revision: 853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa
File: tsf.h
License: TSF-LICENSE (MIT; also embedded in the header)

Local modifications: _TSFREGIONOFFSET and _TSFREGIONENVOFFSET use offsetof / sizeof
instead of subtraction from null pointers, preserving their type-index units
without undefined pointer arithmetic. The adapter includes stddef.h.
Line endings normalized to LF. No upstream contribution is being made.
